title: 🔴 NEW MSFS AUSTRALIA! 🇦🇺 World Update 21 & CAC Boomerang First Flight! (LIVE)
description:
G'day pilots! Today we are heading Down Under for the massive release of World Update 21: Australia! We are also jumping into the cockpit of the brand new Local Legend 24: The CAC Boomerang, the legendary Australian-built WWII fighter.

From the Sydney Opera House to the red sands of the outback, Microsoft Flight Simulator has completely transformed Australia with new photogrammetry and handcrafted airports.

In this live stream:
✈️ First Flight: Testing the CAC Boomerang (Local Legend 24)
🏙️ 40 New Cities: Touring Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, and more!
🏝️ New Airports: Landing at Lord Howe Island, Broome, and Coober Pedy.
🇦🇺 Exploration: Checking out the Twelve Apostles and the Blue Mountains.

Is your home town finally in 3D? Join the chat and let me know where we should fly next!

Official Links:

World Update 21: https://www.flightsimulator.com/world-update-21/

Local Legend 24 (Boomerang): https://www.flightsimulator.com/local-legend-24/
